requirements.description: Cozy witch-academy palette, terrain treatment, prop density and unit readability at game scale; original identity, no bundled example art
Ground reads as continuous regions; no dominant repeated diamonds, mirrored texture stamps or per-tile color checkerboard
Paving/path/grass and bank boundaries continuous through bends and junctions with consistent pixel treatment and readable traversal
Fountain, trees and raised dais read as coherent multi-tile structures with consistent style and scale; dais side faces match top surface
Whole silhouette, stable root and correct facing through all four walk cycles and their wraps
Readable hit flinch and cast wind-up/release clips during battle, whole silhouette, stable root
Stream flow follows the channel, joins remain covered and pause freezes it; fountain splash loop stable
Trees and planted foliage sway with stable loops and varied cadence; pause freezes all
Turn order, move ranges with reachable highlight, melee and ranged attack with damage numbers, guard, height advantage, win/lose/reset; all map commands reachable
Units cannot leave the map or enter water/occupied cells; ranged spell respects range and elevation; blocking props reserved
Record median/p95 frame intervals, renderer and blank baseline; assess against the brief

comparisons.focus: Shared pixel treatment, materials, hierarchy and unit readability
Style and readability at the mobile playing scale
Continuous ground without dominant tile stamps
Variation across cells and coherent larger regions
Interlocking material edges with shared pixel density
Raised structure reads as one composed object with matching faces
Fountain and trees consistent in style and scale
